mapper.select:
select plan_date, glue, sum(ifnull( total_plan_qty, 0 )) as total_plan_qty, sum(ifnull( mid_plan_qty, 0 )) as mid_plan_qty, group_concat(CASE WHEN MID_REMARK_RWN = 1 THEN MID_REMARK END ORDER BY mid_remark SEPARATOR ',' ) AS mid_remark, sum(ifnull( night_plan_qty, 0 )) as night_plan_qty, group_concat(CASE WHEN NIGHT_REMARK_RWN = 1 THEN NIGHT_REMARK END ORDER BY night_remark SEPARATOR ',') AS night_remark, sum(ifnull( day_plan_qty, 0 )) as day_plan_qty, group_concat(CASE WHEN DAY_REMARK_RWN = 1 THEN DAY_REMARK END ORDER BY day_remark SEPARATOR ',') AS day_remark from ( SELECT DISTINCT plan_date, glue, total_plan_qty, mid_plan_qty, mid_remark, row_number() over (partition by GLUE,MID_REMARK) as MID_REMARK_RWN, night_plan_qty, night_remark, row_number() over (partition by GLUE,night_remark) as night_remark_RWN, day_plan_qty, day_remark, row_number() over (partition by GLUE,day_remark) as DAY_REMARK_RWN FROM t_glue_demand_plan_init WHERE del_flag = '0'
and plan_date >= str_to_date(#{startTime},'%Y-%m-%d')
and plan_date <= str_to_date(#{endTime},'%Y-%m-%d')
and factory = #{factory} and INSTR(glue, #{glue}) > 0 ) t GROUP BY plan_date, GLUE
order by plan_date, GLUE desc
order by ${orderStr}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_GLUE_DEMAND_PLAN_INIT_LOG ( ID, BATCH_NO, PLAN_DATE, IMPORT_DATE, FACTORY, IMPORT_FACTORY, GLUE, GLUE_NAME, SAP_CODE, STOCK_QTY, DAY_PLAN_SURPLUS, ACTUAL_FINISH, MIX_AREA, VEHICLE_WEIGHT, TOTAL_PLAN_QTY, VEHICLE_DESK, MID_PLAN_QTY, MID_COLLAR, MID_REMARK, NIGHT_PLAN_QTY, NIGHT_COLLAR, NIGHT_REMARK, DAY_PLAN_QTY, DAY_COLLAR, DAY_REMARK, NEXT_MID_PLAN_QTY, NOT_COLLAR, DATA_SOURCE, REMARK, DEL_FLAG, CREATE_BY, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_BY, UPDATE_TIME ) SELECT ID, BATCH_NO, PLAN_DATE, IMPORT_DATE, FACTORY, IMPORT_FACTORY, GLUE, GLUE_NAME, SAP_CODE, STOCK_QTY, DAY_PLAN_SURPLUS, ACTUAL_FINISH, MIX_AREA, VEHICLE_WEIGHT, TOTAL_PLAN_QTY, VEHICLE_DESK, MID_PLAN_QTY, MID_COLLAR, MID_REMARK, NIGHT_PLAN_QTY, NIGHT_COLLAR, NIGHT_REMARK, DAY_PLAN_QTY, DAY_COLLAR, DAY_REMARK, NEXT_MID_PLAN_QTY, NOT_COLLAR, DATA_SOURCE, REMARK, DEL_FLAG, CREATE_BY, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_BY, UPDATE_TIME FROM T_GLUE_DEMAND_PLAN_INIT WHERE DEL_FLAG = 0 AND PLAN_DATE = #{planDate} AND FACTORY = #{factory}
mapper.delete: delete from t_glue_demand_plan_init where plan_date = #{planDate} and factory = #{factory}
